# Camp Resource: Caged Rabbit

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 24, 2024
- 1 min read

Updated: Jul 30, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_751cf2a893a34494b20e468ec179ba73~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __Mette__

Add your very own rabbit to your C.A.M.P. with the Caged Rabbit.

Generates fertilizer.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Caged Rabbit__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_33d655ffb4f94972870c52b7fd4753c7~mv2.png)

**Produces**

Fertilizer

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Caged Rabbit, Chicken Coop, and Rad-Pheasant Coop.

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

10 Fertilizer

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Helvetia Easter C.A.M.P. Bundle__ - 1800 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

1 minute and 48 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

9 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
